name: led-duris-e-2835-cri90
description: OSRAM DURIS E 2835 GW JTLPS1.CM white LED, CRI 90 min / 92 typ, R9>=50, 150 mA nominal (250 mA max), Vf 2.70-3.30 V (2.94 typ), Rth 25 K/W. Stocked variant: 6500 K (LCSC C17297932); other CCTs of the same part use the same footprint

cct.description: colour temperature (informational; must match the LCSC part)

lcsc.description: LCSC part; C17297932 = GW JTLPS1.CM-JNKN-XX51 6500 K

vf_trim.description: forward-voltage offset in volts for this LED (bin/part spread; series source V<ref>_trim also measures the LED current)

spice.model:
* fitted to the datasheet I-V curve of the typical (L2-group) part: 2.94 V @ 150 mA, ~3.05 V @ 200 mA; tempco -1.7 mV/K (SPICE gives dVf/dT = (Vf_junction - EG - XTI*Vt)/T, so EG is a fitting value here, not the physical bandgap).
* Datasheet forward-voltage groups at 150 mA: K2 2.70-2.80, L1 2.80-2.90, L2 2.90-3.00, M1 3.00-3.10, M2 3.10-3.20, N1 3.20-3.30 V.
* The reel's group is on its label (e.g. `HN-35-K2`); vf_trim shifts this instance by that much (+0.36 = worst-case N1).
.model DURIS_E_CM D(IS=1e-20 N=2.5 RS=0.9 EG=3.26 XTI=2 CJO=60p TT=5n BV=8)

metadata.rotation_note: polarity: cathode is the wide pad on the package-mark side; verify in JLCPCB's placement preview and set rotation_offset if their reel orientation differs
